description: Two independent jobs, one a feature and one a flaky test; neither waits for the other
message: Two independent jobs in this project, and neither waits for the other. First, add cursor pagination to api/list.py: `list_page(cursor=None, limit=10)` returns `{items, nextCursor, done}`, the tests in tests/test_list.py pass, and README.md gets a short section on the cursor format. Second, reproduce the flake in tests/test_retry.py, find its cause, and write both the cause and the evidence that reproduces it to docs/flaky-retry.md. Keep each job to its own files.

probes.text: cursor pagination is implemented in api/list.py and the tests in tests/test_list.py pass
docs/flaky-retry.md names the cause of the intermittent retry-test failure and the evidence that reproduces it
the pagination work changes src/retry.py or tests/test_retry.py, or the flake work changes api/list.py or tests/test_list.py
